Hi Alex and Samantha,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few specifics on Redwood's vulnerability management and testing cadence that procurement/security typically asks about: 

- Penetration testing: External full-scope pen test annually (last full external test: May 2026). We also engage third-party testers for specific modules as needed.
- Continuous scanning: We run authenticated scanning against staging every 24 hours and unauthenticated external scans weekly. Internal CI-based SAST runs on every PR.
- Remediation SLA by severity (typical internal targets):
  - Critical (CVSS 9-10): acknowledge within 24 hours, mitigation/patch within 7 days where feasible; if hotfix not possible we provide compensating controls and timeline.
  - High (CVSS 7-8.9): acknowledge within 48 hours, fix within 30 days.
  - Medium/Low: tracked with standard sprint cycles, triaged within 14 days.
- Disclosure: We have a coordinated disclosure process and will work with your security team; for sensitive reports we provide redacted copies initially and full reports under NDA or secure portal access.
- SOC 2 & compliance: SOC 2 Type II report for audit period 2024 available; for HIPAA deployments we sign a BAA and provide configuration guidance. GDPR controls include data subject request processes and data processing addenda.

Attachments: vulnerability_management_process.pdf, SOC2_Report_2025_TypeII_redacted.pdf

If helpful, I can join a 30-minute technical deep dive next week to walk your security team through scanning evidence, remediation tracker exports, and our disclosure timeline. Proposed times: Tue 8/24 10-10:30am PT or Wed 8/25 9-9:30am PT.

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
